subject: Capacity & procurement timeline — HelixApps dedicated pool
messages:
From: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@cloudedge.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@helixapps.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity availability for HelixApps — initial window

Sean / team,

Following up on our call from last week — HelixApps is planning a dedicated capacity purchase tied to an enterprise contract (Win: D-HELI-2026-0912). We ran an availability check for our US-west fleet. High level: we have limited contiguous rack capacity in 2026 W44-W46 and a larger window starting mid-November, but OEM delivery is the gating factor for on-prem racks.

Questions to help us scope and provide a firm timeline/quote:
- Target start date for production traffic (when Redwood needs the pool live)?
- Preferred GPU family (A100 / H100 / custom quantized variants)?
- Typical concurrent sessions / tail latency SLOs you expect (p50/p95)?
- Any strict compliance window (SOC2 audit or on-prem requirement) that would force private only?

Attached: CloudCapacityWindowQ4.xlsx (availability windows by region).

We can offer a provisional reservation for the Helix deal if you confirm approximate sizing by EOD Wednesday (10/14). If OEM hardware is needed, we can initiate preliminary RFQ now but lead times vary by vendor. Happy to jump on a quick 30-min sync with your procurement and Karthik.

Best,
Lisa Turner
Senior Account Executive — CloudEdge
lisa.turner@cloudedge.com
+1 415 555 2121

--
Attachment: CloudCapacityWindowQ4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@helixapps.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity availability for HelixApps — initial window

Thanks Lisa — good summary. Quick answers and context from Redwood / Helix side:
- Target production start: beta traffic in week of 11/22, full production by 12/06. We need a staged approach: cloud-hosted dedicated pool first (to meet beta), then OEM racks on-prem at Helix's Colo by early December.
- Preferred GPUs: primary target H100 80GB (quantized tbd). Fallback: A100 80GB.
- Expected steady-state concurrency: ~280 concurrent sessions, peak bursts up to 420 for short windows. P95 latency SLO 350ms for short-gen prompts (2k tokens).
- Compliance: Helix requires encryption-at-rest + audit logs; SOC2 is required before renewal but not gating initial deploy.

I've attached our workload profile for this engagement (Helix_workload_profile_v3.pdf) — it includes sample prompt distributions and expected token-per-call distributions.

Please do the OEM RFQ and share lead times. Karthik / Maya / Neha — can you validate this sizing and produce a quick sizing calc so Lisa and OEMs have a concrete ask? Also please flag any fallback models that reduce capacity by >30% so we can plan a blended strategy.

I'll schedule a 30-min sync for tomorrow afternoon to align on timelines.

Thanks,
Sean
VP, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
+1 650 555 0199

--
Attachment: Helix_workload_profile_v3.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@cloudedge.com>
Cc: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@helixapps.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity availability for HelixApps — initial window

Sean / Lisa — attached is a first-pass sizing spreadsheet based on Sean's workload profile. High-level bullets:
- Baseline (beta): 40 H100 80GB (VGPU partitioning where useful) — should meet early concurrency/load for week of 11/22 with autoscale headroom.
- Full production (12/06 target): 90 H100-equivalent cards across dedicated pool + on-prem racks. If we mix A100 for fallback, add ~25% more physical cards due to perf delta.
- Short-term cloud burst buffer: recommend reserving an additional 20% capacity with CloudEdge pre-reserve to cover the first 6–8 weeks while OEM racks are delivered.
- KV cache and prefix reuse expected to reduce tokens-per-call by ~12% after warm-up; include that in throughput.

I've attached: dedicated_sizing_calc.xlsx and expected_qps_chart.png.

Open questions for procurement:
1) Do we want OEM new-build racks or refurbished listings? Lead-time / cost tradeoffs are big (OEM quoted lead times below).
2) Are we comfortable with staged delivery (cloud-first) and final cutover to on-prem once racks arrive?

Lisa — can you confirm CloudEdge will hold the provisional reservation through W46 if we submit by tomorrow? That buys us time for the OEM procurement path.

Karthik
Head of Platform Engineering — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
--
Attachment: dedicated_sizing_calc.xlsx (spreadsheet, 240KB)
Attachment: expected_qps_chart.png (image, 85KB)

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 16:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity availability for HelixApps — initial window 

Hi all — Marco from Titan GPU (OEM) here. Thanks for the sizing notes. We ran this internally and can provide the following options for Helix (lead times are calendar weeks from PO):

- New-build H100 racks (factory): 12–16 weeks. Typical MOQ 4 racks. Full warranty + option for onsite install.
- Refurb H100 units: 8–10 weeks (limited inventory; performance varies by batch).
- Expedited build: 6 weeks (premium surcharge ~22% and refundable deposit 30%).

Preliminary commercial: OEM_Titan_quote_Helix_2026-10-13.pdf attached — includes per-unit pricing, shipping, and a sample maintenance SOW. We can also provide a letter of intent to reserve a production slot if Redwood/Helix commits to the deposit.

Notes: rack-level lead times are sensitive to firmware release windows. If you need new-build in late-November, we recommend ordering this week to hit a mid-December on-site timeframe.

Happy to discuss options on a quick call — Marco

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Jenna Park <jenna.park@helixapps.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity availability for HelixApps — initial window (Next steps)

Team — thanks for the fast turn. Summary and decisions:

1) Immediate (by 10/15): Lisa/CloudEdge to hold a provisional reservation for a cloud dedicated buffer equal to +20% of Karthik's baseline. This covers beta in week of 11/22.
2) OEM order (by 10/18): We will move forward with Titan refurbished units (8–10 week lead time) to hit an early-December on-site window. Marco — please provide the PO-ready line items and cancellation terms by EOD Monday (10/18). We prefer refurb for lead-time and cost; if refurb inventory drops, escalate to new-build expedited option.
3) Procurement / Finance: Alex Chen (ProcurePlus) — please prepare a PO and payment terms for Helix (deal D-HELI-2026-0912). Use PO_request_template.docx as the starting doc. Estimate: place an initial deposit equal to 30% if expedited; otherwise standard 20% deposit.
4) Cutover plan: Karthik / Maya to prepare a short runbook for traffic cutover from CloudEdge pool -> on-prem Titan racks (include KV cache warm-up and model pinning steps). Target cutover window: 12/06–12/08.

Action owners and deadlines:
- Lisa: hold space and confirm reservation by 10/15.
- Marco: PO-ready quote + cancellation T&Cs by 10/18.
- Alex: draft PO and payment schedule by 10/19.
- Karthik/Maya: cutover runbook by 11/24.

If nobody objects, I'll route this summary to Finance and Legal for the final PO and MSA signature. Thanks everyone for the quick coordination — this mixed strategy should keep Helix live while reducing unit economics.

Sean
